name: E-Commerce Add-to-Cart and Badge Count Increment
description: Adding an item from the product catalog must increment the visual shopping cart badge count from 0 to 1 and reflect the item in the cart view.
invariants: Cart badge count increments by exactly 1 for each added product item
Add-to-cart button text or selector toggles to Remove state

scenario_templates.title: Add Product Item to Cart and Verify Badge Count
scenario_templates.objective: Verify clicking add-to-cart on an item increments the shopping cart badge count to 1.

steps.description: Click add-to-cart on primary product item

domain_assumptions: Selector hints, routes, option values and expected texts in this template were authored against one reference application (SauceDemo-style e-commerce). They are hypotheses: the planner uses a step or expectation only when it is observed on the current target.

name: E-Commerce Cart Item Removal and Badge Reset
description: Removing an item from the cart decreases the badge count or removes the badge completely when empty.
preconditions: Shopping cart contains at least 1 item
invariants: Removing the sole item from cart clears the badge count element or sets count to 0
Removed item is no longer visible in the cart item list

scenario_templates.title: Remove Item From Shopping Cart
scenario_templates.objective: Verify clicking remove inside cart drops item from list and clears badge.
